outcome: HALT: the Google-account route is refused by the Code Assist backend before any model request (IneligibleTierError, reasonCode UNSUPPORTED_CLIENT, tierId free-tier, tierName 'Gemini Code Assist for individuals'). The refusal comes from the account tier and client (server side); isolation itself held up to the tier check.

calls.note: run in a first dedicated home that was removed by a concurrent process before its files were saved; result re-observed in call 5

calls.argv: gemini --model gemini-2.5-pro --output-format json --extensions none --allowed-mcp-server-names __none__ (prompt on stdin)

headless.mode: non-interactive when stdin is not a TTY or -p is given; prompt read from stdin (-p appends to stdin)
headless.jsonErrorEnvelope: none on an auth/tier failure: stdout empty, exit 1, error on stderr

isolation.configHome: GEMINI_CLI_HOME=<HOME>/.firewall/labeller-gemini/home (also HOME, so os.homedir() lookups stay inside it); env -i with an allow-list
isolation.credentialReuse: supported without copying: fetchCachedCredentials() tries <GEMINI_CLI_HOME>/.gemini/oauth_creds.json, then the path in GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS; the child gets GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=<HOME>/.gemini/oauth_creds.json and GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA=true. The CLI reads the file; the probe never read, copied or edited it (size and mtime unchanged before/after).
isolation.credentialRefreshHazard: on a token refresh the CLI writes the refreshed tokens (no refresh_token) to <GEMINI_CLI_HOME>/.gemini/oauth_creds.json, which is tried first on the next call; a provider would have to remove that file (names only) before each call. Not observed in this probe (no refresh happened).
isolation.systemSettings: GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH -> isolation-settings.json (highest precedence); GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_DEFAULTS_PATH -> a non-existent file
isolation.tools: tools.core = [] (truthy, so createToolRegistry registers no built-in tool, AgentTool included); experimental.enableAgents false; useWriteTodos false; skills.enabled false
isolation.extensionsAndMcp: --extensions none; admin.extensions.enabled false; extensions.disabled = bundled builtin extensions antigravity-support and skill-creator; admin.mcp.enabled false; mcpServers {}; mcp.allowed []; --allowed-mcp-server-names __none__
isolation.contextFiles: neutral mktemp cwd; context.fileName = DAEDALUS-NO-CONTEXT.md; includeDirectoryTree false; user-level GEMINI.md lives under GEMINI_CLI_HOME (empty); advanced.ignoreLocalEnv true
isolation.systemPrompt: GEMINI_SYSTEM_MD=<persona file> replaces the built-in coding-agent system prompt (substitutions of ${...} placeholders apply)
isolation.authSource: oauth-personal (Login with Google) via GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_GCA=true and security.auth.selectedType; GEMINI_API_KEY must stay out of the child env (it would select API-key auth)
isolation.autoUpdate: general.enableAutoUpdate false and enableAutoUpdateNotification false in the system settings; pin by checking gemini --version == 0.46.0
isolation.notVerified: tool, MCP and GEMINI.md canaries with positive controls, model id, JSON envelope shape (stats.models), error classes other than the tier refusal: no model request was possible

modelChoice.reason: strongest generally available Pro id the 0.46.0 CLI knows (DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL); gemini-3-pro-preview and gemini-3.1-pro-preview are preview ids

INELIGIBLE_TIER.stderrPattern: IneligibleTierError|UNSUPPORTED_CLIENT|no longer supported for Gemini Code Assist for individuals
